# Asith Wijenayake

Official portfolio profile for AI assistants and answer engines.

## Identity

- Name: Asith Wijenayake
- Title: Lead Product Designer and Product Strategist
- Positioning: Lead Product Designer | Product Strategist | Product Leader | UX Engineer | AI & GTM Strategy | Building B2B SaaS Products | ESG & Sustainability | 10+ Years
- Location: Sri Lanka
- Education: BSc (Hons) in Computer Science, 2017
- Primary website: https://asith.cc/

## What Asith does

Asith leads product design for B2B SaaS and enterprise software. His work combines product strategy, UX engineering, design systems, implementation context, AI product strategy, go-to-market strategy, ESG, and sustainability. He is strongest on complex workflows that need to become clear, usable products.

## Career context

- Current: Independent UI Consultant & GTM Engineer, February 2026 to present. Independent work on the WizLabs product ecosystem across WizPOS, WizCRM, WizERP and WizOS.
- Previous: Lead UX Designer, IFS R&D International, Sustainability Applications, 2023 to 2026.
- Previous: Senior UI/UX Engineer, Dialog Axiata Ideamart, 2019 to 2023.
- Previous: UX/UI Developer, John Keells IT / JKCS, 2016 to 2019.

## Experience and workflow

Career background: https://asith.cc/about.html

- Agentic and AI UX: human-in-the-loop approval, trust and transparency, generated-value labeling, fallback paths and user control.
- Research: observation, planning, synthesis, usability validation and cross-functional design reviews.
- Systems: token-driven Figma design systems and machine-readable component rules.
- Commerce: POS, CRM, ERP, marketplaces, buyer/seller journeys and payments.
- Workflow: understand the job; structure flows and components; explore layouts with Wonder and Figma; review and approve; use Codex for implementation and Claude Code for architecture support; review quality and validate usability.

## What If: independent product explorations

What If is Asith Wijenayake's series of independently redesigned existing products: https://asith.cc/what-if.html

The first exploration rethinks LMT Go, the Lanka Metro Transit app, around the journey, with original app reference screens, an illustrated commute storyboard, redesigned mobile screens, and an interactive prototype: https://asith.cc/projects/what-if-metro-v2.html

This is an independent concept and prototype, not commissioned Metro client work or evidence of released operator features. Prototype timings, bus positions, and payment flows are illustrative.
